logp.method_description: A hydrophobicity test was performed for the synthesized complexes employing the “shake-flask” method and octanol–water phase partition coefficient. The complex was dissolved in a mixture of water and octanol, followed by shaking for 24 h. Then, the mixture was allowed to settle for 30 min or centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 20 min. The resulting two phases were collected separately without cross-contamination of one solvent layer into the other. The concentration of the complex in each phase was determined by UV-visible absorption spectroscopy at room temperature. The presented results are the mean values obtained from three independent experiments. The sample solution concentration was used to calculate log Po/w.
